identificationModule.briefTitle: A Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of TQB3702 Tablets Combined With Immunochemotherapy for the Treatment of B-cell Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of TQB3702 Tablets Combined With Immunochemotherapy for the Treatment of B-cell Lymphoma

leadSponsor.name: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of TQB3702 tablets combined with immunochemotherapy for the treatment of B-cell lymphoma

armGroups.label: TQB3702 tablets+Chemotherapy regimen
armGroups.description:
TQB3702 tablets 200mg, every 4 weeks for a treatment cycle.

Chemotherapy regimen：Every 3 or 4 weeks is a treatment cycle, with 6 or 12 cycles of combination therapy

interventions.name: TQB3702 tablets+Chemotherapy regimen
interventions.description:
TQB3702 tablets: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor；

Chemotherapy regimen：inhibiting tumor cell proliferation, suppressing DNA synthesis, inducing cell apoptosis, enhancing immune system function, and inhibiting angiogenesis；

primaryOutcomes.description: According to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1.the proportion of subjects whose tumors are evaluated as complete response(CR) and partial response(PR) by subcenter imaging evaluation. It is recorded from the first use of the drug to disease progression or initiation of a new anticancer treatment.
The rate of complete tumor remission

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Adverse events (AE) and serious adverse events (SAE)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AE) and serious adverse events (SAE), as well as abnormal laboratory test indicators

secondaryOutcomes.measure: ORR and CRR at the end of combination therapy
secondaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate and complete remission rate at the end of combination therapy.
PFS defined as the time from first dose to the first documented progressive disease (PD) or death from any cause.
The period from the participants first achieving CR or PR to disease progression
OS is defined as the time from the first administration to all-cause death
1-year Progression-free survival and Overall survival rates
2-years Progression-free survival and Overall survival rates
